specs.description: `index.mjs` — Index. This project's call graph records DIRECT calls only, so a function passed to a container, destructured into an exported binding, or reached through a dynamic lookup is not one it can see. Within that limit it records no call to this module. At least one of its operations is exported. At run time it reaches `core` and `spelling`. `renderTalk` builds `text`, and no requirement here is about what runs inside it. `readImage` has 2 failure conditions and 1 of them is stated here — the rest are in the findings in Predictable Code (the Control Center, or your editor). Checks: “`renderTalk` fails with "renderTalk needs the pieces folder" unless `pieces` is present and is not falsy.” 3 requirements: 2 violated, 1 verified. 3 stated failures.
